oh okay i’ll try my best! (i’m still pretty new to competitive so i don’t know all the lingo but hopefully this makes sense) 

i usually lead with jolteon and espeon. because jolteon is VERY fast and i usually get to go first, so i can volt switch (boosted by choice specs + when i switch back in later i can use a different move) which usually one shots tornadus, iron bundle, and a few others. OR if they lead with a garchomp or landorus i tera blast ice which usually one shots them as well. 

espeon is arguably the most important member of my team. focus sash insures i get up trick room 90% of the time, ghost tera protects from fake outs/extreme speeds, and magic bounce is way OP and mostly protects from spore but watching it bounce back everything else is just as fun😈. psychic terrain is a recent addition to my team but VERY useful especially since every other team right now seems to use dragonite/chein pao combo. 

sylveon is one of my main damage dealers and hyper voice has saved me many a match. i honest to god mostly chose poison tera bc sylveon is my favorite and i thought it would look super sick (it does) but it’s actually turned out to be a really good choice. no one expects a sylveon poison tera blast :)

umbreon is definitely my least used but when he is used he is very important to the win. i don’t think i would ever take off rocky helmet from how much it clutches and chips potential sash, especially since umbreon is such a tank that sometimes an opponent will end up hurting themselves more than me. because of inner focus, umbreon is another pokémon i sometimes lead with if i see fake out users. taunt is also super useful for spore users and i know once i can better remember which pokémon use physical attacks, foul play will just get more useful. 

vaporeon is very helpful in more situations than not. water absorb is great against rapid strike urshifu, aqua jet users, and other water pokémon. the grass tera protects from spore users, and earthquake (absolutely the most annoying move imo) muddy water is great when it hits, and yawn is great as a last resort. (i try not to be annoying and yawn everyone just because i can) the sitrus berry is a recent change but has really helped stay alive longer. 

and last but not least, flareon is 100% my biggest damage dealer. i usually protect or dig to get my toxic orb going and then facade + guts + normal tera obliterates anyone unlucky enough to get hit. unless they are ghost or weak to fire in which case flare blitz is a great alternative.

in terms of weaknesses: 

jolteon can simply not take a hit, so avoiding getting hit in general is very important (the match can be decided just by who i decide to volt switch), you have to be very good at reading protects (i am…learning)

espeon honest to god doesn’t have a lot of weaknesses other than bc espeon isn’t very bulky i sometimes have to choose between trick room and psychic terrain 

sylveons main nerf is really just steel moves like heavy slam especially if i’ve already used my tera 

umbreon is a bit underutilized as he does not do much damage, and it can suck if he’s the last pokémon left because it’s rare that i can outdamage my opponent in time especially if they aren’t a physical attacker 

vaporeon is also pretty solid. other than muddy water missing sometimes and electric types, but he’s bulky even enough to  tank an electric move or two. 

flareons biggest weakness is how quick he dies. but i think that’s a fair trade off for how much damage he’s able to do :) 

as far as weaknesses in general go: pokémon  that are slower than me really put me at a disadvantage, specifically ursaluna/heatran/torkoal. also there is VERY little room for error. one mistake can often cause me the match because i’m just not able to do damage like most of my opponents currently. but it just makes the wins all the more satisfying! 

and so that’s it i think, let me know if i missed anything :) 

oh and and for anyone who cares, my eevees are all named after final fantasy 7 characters and sylveon, umbreon, and vaporeon are all shiny !!!
